# FounderCal

FounderCal is an independent directory of startup accelerators, fellowships and grant opportunities with source links and review dates.

## Read the evidence

- [Research policy](https://foundercal.org/methodology): status definitions, uncertainty and review cadence.
- [Program directory](https://foundercal.org/imported-accelerators): canonical program pages with official evidence.
- [Current catalog JSON](https://foundercal.org/catalog.json): organizations, programs, cohorts and application rounds.
- [Calendar events JSON](https://foundercal.org/events.json): published event dates and source provenance.

## Interpret carefully

A review date is not proof that applications remain open. Unknown dates are not rolling admissions. Funding maxima are not guaranteed investments. Program start dates are not application deadlines. Follow the official source before advising someone to apply.

Historical legacy data in events-archive.json is not current evidence. Calendar downloads are snapshots, not live subscriptions.
